caseName: Where the performance actually is in a nozzle, ranked, on the hub's booster
linkedCaseNote: The chamber pressure, area ratio and ascent profile are the propulsion hub's design point. Restated here so the example runs standalone; a cross-domain test asserts they still match.

ascent._comment: The same representative first stage profile the hub uses, sampled at equal intervals of burn time.

hubResult._comment: What the propulsion hub concluded, carried here so the example can test it against a different separation criterion. The hub used Summerfield, which forbade its own burn-average optimum.
